histogram.name: ActivityReporter.IncompleteReports
histogram.summary: Records the number of activity report update checks still in progress when the activity reporter is destroyed during a clean shutdown. Such reports may have reached the server, but their responses were not processed. Emitted once per session that reports activity; not emitted on Android or after crashes, and rarely on iOS. Typically uploaded on the next browser launch.

histogram.name: ActivityReporter.InitialDateLastActiveState
histogram.summary: Records the persisted DateLastActive state of the Chrome activity app id in Local State for the Chrome Activity Reporter on the first ReportActive() call in a session. Emitted at most once per browser session, and only in sessions that report activity. Used to diagnose whether prior sessions failed to persist DateLastActive data (e.g., due to a race during browser shutdown).

histogram.name: ActivityReporter.PingFreshnessAge
histogram.summary: Records how long ago the ping freshness value was written, when the Chrome Activity Reporter starts an update check for an activity report. update_client writes a new value after each successful update check. When the ActivityReporterPingFreshnessRotation feature is enabled, the reporter also writes a new value right after it records this histogram, if the value has reached the max age (the feature's PingFreshnessRotationMaxAge parameter: 53 hours by default, clamped to between 24 hours and 28 days), or if the time it was written is unknown or in the future. Recorded before that replacement, so samples can exceed the max age. Not recorded when there is no value yet, or when the time the value was written is unknown or in the future (see ActivityReporter.PingFreshnessState). Samples are truncated to whole hours: ages under 1 hour fall in the underflow bucket, and ages of 28 days or more in the overflow bucket. Emitted at most once every 5 hours in a browser session.

histogram.name: ActivityReporter.PingFreshnessState
histogram.summary: Records the state of the ping freshness value when the Chrome Activity Reporter starts an update check for an activity report. A value expires when it reaches the max age, which the PingFreshnessRotationMaxAge parameter of the ActivityReporterPingFreshnessRotation feature sets: 53 hours by default, clamped to between 24 hours and 28 days. When the feature is enabled, the reporter then replaces values that are expired, or whose write time is unknown or in the future. Emitted at most once every 5 hours in a browser session.
